unit: one incident decision; human analyses cluster by participant and retrospective analyses by pipeline

fields.participant_id: null for non-human routes; never an agent ID presented as a human
fields.source_packet_sha256: hash of complete source/effective input/capture packet
fields.assignment_id: frozen randomized assignment identifier or null
fields.original_run_uid: actual terminal failed run UID, when historical
fields.failure_roots: list of actual failed/cancelled task identities
fields.effective_resource_observations_sha256: hash; absence of observation is explicit
fields.information_packet_sha256: shared domain facts and available observations
fields.policy_or_rule_sha256: content hash or null; not authenticated provenance
fields.authoring_active_seconds: observed elapsed active work, never inferred from row counts
fields.maintenance_active_seconds: observed active work for actual revision
fields.first_action: rerun selection or refusal with reason
fields.first_selected_tasks: explicit list; oracle never reads it as correctness ground truth
fields.first_error_class: unsafe_omission | unnecessary_repeat | incorrect_refusal | required_refusal | no_error | unscorable
fields.oracle_coverage_record: artifact IDs/API responses and complete work coverage
fields.native_status: True | False | Unknown | not_executed; independent of semantic validity
fields.warnings: codes and exact messages from common generator
fields.original_successful_task_seconds_potenti: sum of original successful TaskRun durations; counterfactual task-work estimate
fields.recovery_elapsed_seconds: actually measured new recovery elapsed time or null
fields.policy_induced_extra_task_count: observed/specified conservative reruns relative to stated comparator
fields.manual_choices_recorded: true only for actual contemporaneous historical choice
fields.automation_strategy: operator notes/scripts/reused mapping; allow baseline automation
fields.provenance_notes: source chronology, coder identity/type and all deviations
